## 3. Overlaps and duplicate authority
- SchedulerConfig / WorkerRegistry: R604.1 redefines what DURABLE-KERNEL-R074/R076.1 own (eg-types/src/scheduler_config.rs exists). Lane rotation/hot-spare in R604.2 and R001.10 repeat PLACEMENT-R002 and R075. Owner: durable-graph-kernel + placement.
- Gauges: R001.13 and R604.5 define the same depth/age metrics. Owner: R604.5.
- Dead letter: R001.9, REPO-INGEST-R002 (DeadLetterItem, R002.650), DURABLE-KERNEL, UDP. Owner: REPO-INGEST-R002.650.
- Unchanged-content filter: R606.2, R003.8 (content_identity), R910.2. Owner: R910. Provenance refusal: R003.10 MissingProvenance vs R606.4 MATERIALIZE_NO_PROVENANCE.
- Outcome set created/updated/unchanged/rejected: R003.700 and R701.5. Owner: R701.
- Transcripts: R003.14-.18 (validator) vs REPO-INGEST-R800 (sources). Owner: R003.14 for identity, R800 for reader/checkpoint.
- Fragment (R700.1) vs ChunkSpan/ProcessedDocument (REPO-INGEST-R652.1). Owner: R652 (processing.rs exists).
- Changeset chain vs branch commit chain: SCM-R002 and BRANCH-MERGE-R002; two-parent merge receipt (BRANCH-MERGE-R007) vs changeset parents. Owner: branch-merge for the chain, SCM for record content.
- GateVerdict: SCM-R008 vs DURABLE-KERNEL-R089.1. Owner: R089.1. Change coupling: SCM-R005 vs REPO-INGEST-R601. Owner: R601. Lock-free acceptance: SCM-R003 vs ENGINE-PARITY-R004. Owner: PARITY-R004.
- REPO-INGEST-R002.100/.101 readback: success reporting is meristem; medulla keeps only the receipt compare.

## 6. Five most common gaps
1. No production call site (crate code never reached from src/): R600.3, R601.3, R603.3, R650.3, R651.3, R002.3, R700.3.
2. Contradictory home: job body in SDK (R001.14) vs engine handlers; eg-capabilities (R001.4) vs "no serde types"; eg-core test paths vs eg-document ownership (R001.1006, R700, R702).
3. Rollup-less boilerplate rows: generic "hot-path proof" and "evidence" text with no values or type (R700.5/.6, R702.5/.6, R605.5, R003.700).
4. Stale or missing symbols: line refs native_routes.rs:408/428/429, source_ingestion.rs:1683/1791 are wrong (466; 1720/1728; 1842); max_working_bytes, CodeMapQuery, SubmitChangeset not on main (R003.9/.11/.15, R006.3/.4, SCM-R002).
5. Defaults left as "configured/calibrated/measurement" (R001.11, R003.2, R003.701, R702.2, R700.4).

## 7. Decisions needed (recommendation first)
1. Where do job bodies/readers run? Recommend: SDK extracts and sends batches to SourceIngest; engine does validation, decompose, score_proposal and readers (R002.3, R003.3, R700.3).
2. One queue authority? Recommend DURABLE-KERNEL R071-R076 + PLACEMENT; delete R001.5/.6/.10, trim R604.1/.2.
3. Branch and changeset chain: one chain (branch-merge), SCM changesets are its records.
4. Object-store commit fence: raft leader publishes, manifest CAS only fences (OBJECT-STORAGE-R003).
5. Conflict winner selection (BRANCH-MERGE-R005, SCM-R009 revert vs fix-forward): decision-engine records the choice.
6. 12 BLANK LANDED REPO-INGEST-R003.* rows: retire or name capabilities. 2000 papers/day (R006.1): a policy choice, not engine code.
